statement: You are given an integer array nums and an integer target.
Find two different indices i and j such that nums[i] + nums[j] == target. The same element may not be used twice, although two elements with equal values at different indices are fine.
Each input has exactly one such pair. Return its two indices, [i, j].

examples.explanation: nums[1] + nums[2] = 2 + 4 = 6. Using the 3 at index 0 twice is not allowed.
The two 3s are different elements, so indices 0 and 1 form the pair.
